messages:
Ivy (AE): Helix Health asked for an "assurance packet" for the POC: SOC 2 excerpt (scope + date), ISO 27001 snapshot, a signed pen-test attestation, a short mapping to HIPAA ePHI controls, and a note on Hosted vs Dedicated cost. They want a single ZIP uploaded to the contract dataroom if possible. Can we assemble by EOD tomorrow?
Zeke (SE): I can pull SOC 2 excerpt and draft a 3-paragraph control summary (auth, encryption, logging). Will note effective date and PCAOB firm.
Asha (Security): I will draft the pen-test attestation and an executive summary (date, scope, top findings, remediation status). Need Legal to confirm signer. Also will include staging scan policy: 48h notice, 3h authenticated window, POC contact alias.
Brian (Legal): I can sign the attestation as Head of Legal. If Helix wants to change wording well review redlines; please don't accept operational commitments in the attestation.
Rafael (SRE): Ill produce a sanitized network/dataflow diagram and a short hosting manifest (region, tenancy type, storage controls). For delivery we can either upload to the contract dataroom or provide a presigned S3 link. Example presign (3-day expiry): `aws s3 presign s3://redwood-evidence/helix-poc-zip --expires-in 259200`
Ivy (AE): They prefer dataroom upload but will accept presigned link if dataroom access takes longer. Also asked about Dedicated POC pricing: is there a minimum commit?
Zeke (SE): Dedicated = 2-week minimum reservation for an isolated POC plus a one-time onboarding fee. Hosted = no reservation, pay-as-you-go; may cost more under sustained heavy load. I will write a short estimate table with low/med/high usage scenarios.
Asha (Security): Clarifying KMS: we use customer-namespaced KMS keys for production; keys are not exported. Staging uses ephemeral credentials rotated per session. I'll include a short control statement.
ArtifactBot: Ticket #POC-4721 created: "Helix POC assurance packet" assigned to Asha, Zeke, Rafael. Due: 2026-01-16.
Ivy (AE): Action list: Asha -> attestation + exec summary; Brian -> signer confirmation; Rafael -> diagram + manifest; Zeke -> SOC2 excerpt + pricing table. Target ZIP upload by 16:00 PT tomorrow.
Brian (Legal): Ill pre-approve the signer text; will sign final document once attestation is in the ticket.
Rafael (SRE): Diagram + manifest ETA: tomorrow 12:00 PT. Ill note which fields are redacted in the README.
Zeke (SE): SOC2 excerpt + pricing ETA: tomorrow 15:00 PT.
Asha (Security): Draft attestation + exec summary ETA: tomorrow 09:30 PT. Will add a short note that we do not provide raw pentest reports without an NDA + explicit agreement.
Ivy (AE): Thanks team  Ill confirm NDA/dataroom access with Helix and loop back. Ping me if anything blocks. :thumbsup:
